meaning: Recycles exceeded: flame sensed then lost 10 times (or PS1 open 10 times) in one call for heat. One-hour lockout.
causes: Dirty flame sensor, dirty burners, poor grounding, sensor location or wire connections
Low or unstable gas manifold pressure
diySteps: Make sure the blower door is properly installed
Technician: measure flame current and manifold pressure during 1st and 2nd stage
Technician: correct incoming gas supply pressure if needed
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: if the lockout repeats.
